text: If you easily seduce a girl, say, on a first date, does that mean that she is a low-quality or easy-to-get girl? Or does it just mean that you are good at seduction? Or maybe you simply got lucky. Here is the truth. Her sleeping with you quickly does not automatically mean anything bad about her. It could just mean she felt the chemistry. It could mean you were confident, smooth, and knew what you were doing. What actually defines whether a girl is right for a relationship? Her actions, her mindset, the way she talks about her life, her goals, her values. Don't judge her based on speed. Judge her based on substance. So no, a fast hookup doesn't mean she is low-quality. It might just mean you both wanted it. Watch her behavior, not just the timing. That's how you spot how good is her character.
